description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange effective from 08.06.2020 to 14.06.2020
reasoning: This gazette notification establishes new rates of exchange for customs duties and other charges under the Customs Ordinance. It constitutes a regulatory framework for financial/commercial transactions related to customs, falling under Legal/Regulatory matters (Type 5) rather than government personnel/structure types. The mention of the Director General is incidental to the regulatory function and does not include detailed portfolio responsibilities that would make it a Hybrid type.
